The main takeaway from our work is that

antibody-bridged beacons (AbBs), which are formed by the binding between an antibody and a pair of SM-modified oligonucleotide (SMO) probes each comprising a stem sequence conjugate with either a fluorophores or a quencher, can serve as a homogeneous assay for the detection of small molecules (SM).
antibody-bridged beacons can be used for the homogeneous detection of small molecule targets, without the need for antibody labeling or immobilization.
the antibody-bridged molecular beacon is a novel and promising platform for the detection of small molecules in homogeneous assays.
